name: com.midmanstudio.hudman
description: Game-agnostic HUD item catalog and layout persistence. HudItemType is a code-generated enum (ScriptableObject-provider + block/priority/lock-file pattern, same shape as com.midmanstudio.utilities' EffectType) so each game contributes its own HUD item catalog without the package ever hardcoding one. HudLayoutRuntime tracks per-item position/scale/opacity/visibility and named layouts with Questly's hybrid persistence split: CaptureState/RestoreState for a host-owned snapshot, SaveToMdix/LoadFromMdix for a package-owned .mdix file. The actual dragging is not reimplemented here -- HudItemDraggableAdapter plugs a HUD item into com.midmanstudio.dragndrop's DragDropController via its uGUI adapter. Deliberately excludes anything about how a game stages its HUD-editing UI (separate scene, overlay, additive load, etc.) -- that's host-specific staging, not package concern.
